positions.title: Experience/Executive Chair
positions.description:
• Manage a student organized beginner-friendly hackathon of 18 directors for women and gender non-conforming students with 600+ participants yearly from 30+ countries (hybrid).
• Responsible for developing the vision, ensuring that all branches of Pearl Hacks are planning the event that follows the mission, and collaborating with the Experience Team to identify problems from previous years and implement solutions

positions.title: Marketing Chair
positions.description:
• Managed and delegated the marketing branch (directors and committee members) to establish Pearl Hack's brand vision and marketing strategy through social media, design, and in person campaigns
• Worked with other branches to facilitate communication between the organization's plans and executions to the general public
• Served as the point of contact for publicity features and communications for the organization

positions.title: Director of Promotion
positions.description:
• Reached 1300+ registrants from 31 countries world-wide
• Managed social media accounts and marketing campaigns
• Communicated the mission of empowerment and inclusion in tech to successfully market the Pearl Hacks brand

positions.title: Software Test Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Automated project creation in Python with static data to improve test pass rates and duration to expedite software releases.
• Improved test run times across 3 teams by ∼400% by eliminating points of failure after modifying existing tests to use automated static projects.
• Analyzed design docs and prototypes of an upcoming feature release to create ∼50 test cases and performed manual testing and triaged 15 bugs with engineers.
positions.insights: Skills: pytest · Python · Jenkins · Selenium · UI Automation · End-to-end Testing

positions.title: Augmented Reality Development Intern
positions.description:
• Researched Augmented Reality capabilities to detect and classify vehicles and their model and loan information for the Innovation Tech Lab.
• Trained an image classifier through CreateML and CoreML with ∼16k dataset images of vehicles with 40% training accuracy.
• Developed an iOS application that displays class labels using the image classifier with XCode and Swift.

positions.title: Computer Science Instructor
positions.description:
• Execute Computer Science lesson plans for students ages 8-18, while adapting to student needs and interests.
• Communicate with parents on a regular basis, providing updates on student progress and results from learning assessments.
• Maintain records for each student, covering multiple courses and skill levels.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Advanced customer relationship management in the Commercial Lending Sector by improving data representation of pending and current loans in Salesforce for the lenders.
• Programmed Salesforce Lightning Web Components and Triggers using HTML/CSS, SOQL, JS, and Apex to retrieve relevant loans for the viewer with sorting capabilities and perform Salesforce actions.
positions.insights: Skills: Salesforce.com Development · Java · Salesforce Training · Apex Programming

projects.title: Hurricane Relief Benefit Concert
projects.description:
Organizer and Host (Rise for Youth) of the Hurricane Relief Benefit Concert

Held at Cat's Cradle in Carrboro, NC

Rise for Youth reached out to local artists to perform at the benefit concert and organized a T-Shirt sale. From the benefit concert, we raised $680 for hurricane relief, which we donated to Coalition of the Homeless in Houston (for Hurricane Harvey), Hurricane Irma Children's Relief Fund by Save the Children, and UNIDOS Disaster Relief Foundation by the Hispanic Federation (for Hurricane Maria).

projects.title: Clovr
projects.description: Clovr is a social networking event for UNC CS students, born of the need for building new connections during COVID-19. It strives to provide a welcoming space for students to make friends, meet people with similar interests, and take time to destress from school. Participants complete a questionnaire and receive matches with similar interests created through our algorithm, with the event culminating in a Zoom Reveal Event* where matches are revealed.

organizations.name: Rise for Youth
organizations.description:
Founder and President of non-school club Rise for Youth, a volunteer group of students from Chapel Hill, NC and San Diego, CA striving to provide more opportunities for extracurriculars and education for the less fortunate

riseyouth.wix.com/rify
